head: Team Jake take the 2026 Cup, 8.5 to 7.5
paras: Sixteen players, two teams, two days at Blue Shamrock, and it went the distance. Team Nate led after Saturday, 4.5 to 3.5. Team Jake won the Sunday singles, 5 points to 3, and finished with 8.5, the number that wins the Cup.
Saturday split down the middle. Team Nate took Fourball matches 1 and 2, Team Jake took 3 and 4. On the Greensomes nine Team Jake won match 1, Team Nate won matches 2 and 4, and match 3 was halved.

Sunday's singles went Team Jake's way. Adam Costa beat Tom Stitt, BJ Kolonia beat Andrew Kabrick, Mohamed Walli beat Bill Steirer and Lou Strohl beat Nate Stettler. Jake Knappenberger against Rich Penberg and Dave Sherwin against Jordan Knappenberger were halved. Team Nate's two wins came from Evan Lindermuth over Chooch Wernett and Harry Pry over Brian Hager.

Closest to the pin was spread around. Jordan Knappenberger took Saturday's par 3s at 8 and 18, Lou Strohl, Evan Lindermuth and Rich Penberg took the others. On Sunday it went to Evan (8), Lou (10), Tom Stitt (15) and Mohamed Walli (18), while nobody found the green on 3.
Evan Lindermuth and Jordan Knappenberger had the best weekends on the money, each up $62. Evan won the Sunday closest-to-pin on 8 with a gross 2 that also took the skin.

days.text: Team Nate 4.5, Team Jake 3.5. Four pairings each played a nine of Fourball and a nine of Greensomes, every nine worth a point.

Team Jake 5, Team Nate 3. Four wins (Costa, Kolonia, Walli, Strohl), two halves (Knappenberger v Penberg, Sherwin v Knappenberger) and two losses (Wernett and Hager) turned a one-point deficit into the Cup.

chips: Biggest weekend: Evan Lindermuth and Jordan Knappenberger, +$62 each
